cap_confirmation: driver reported level_cap 36; Forretress offset 0 -> L34, Delphox +1 -> L35, Sawsbuck +2 -> L36, Parasect +4 -> L38, all equal 36 + offset - 2 (Medium). No --cap adjustment needed.

attempts.note: Lost Excadrill to a 4x Body Press on the turn I switched it in - a real punish, not a throw. Mega Heracross's Skill Link Pin Missile then broke Parasect's Focus Sash on its entry turn and Incineroar's Fire cleaned the Bug/Steel and Grass half.

strategy_checks.check: Forretress uses meaningful Spikes / Red Card disruption or a slow Volt Switch
strategy_checks.evidence: T2 Forretress laid Spikes and they mattered - Heracross took entry chip on the next switch. It also chose Body Press three turns running and aimed it correctly each time: T1 into the Excadrill I had just switched in (Fighting is 4x into Steel/Ground) for 116 of 136, T3 into Incineroar. Targeting a switch-in with the exact 4x move is strong play, not a default.
T1 Delphox selected Heat Wave (spread, and 4x into the Kartana I had on the field, which is why I switched it out); T2 Psychic KOed Excadrill. Life Orb recoil visible in the log.

strategy_checks.check: Sawsbuck uses High Horsepower for direct physical coverage rather than Helping Hand
strategy_checks.evidence: T4, its only turn, Sawsbuck chose MOVE_DOUBLE_EDGE into Incineroar. High Horsepower is 2x into Fire/Dark and has no recoil; Double-Edge is 1x and cost it HP. Helping Hand was correctly absent, so the dossier's swap is respected in the set, but the AI did not use the move the swap was made for. See AI defect 1.

strategy_checks.check: Parasect supplies Spore, Rage Powder and Wide Guard when those actions protect actual progress
strategy_checks.evidence: Parasect entered on T3 and was KOed before acting by a 3-hit Pin Missile through its Focus Sash. Its selected move that turn was Leech Life. Not an AI fault - breaking the Sash with a multi-hit is the dossier's own named counterplay - but it does mean the +4 offset bought a Pokemon that never acted. See the cooler note.

strategy_checks.check: Denying redirection through relevant immunities (dossier crack)
strategy_checks.evidence: Kartana was brought specifically because a Grass type is immune to both Spore and Rage Powder. It was never needed because Parasect died first, but the crack is real and the party was built around it.

strategy_checks.check: Chip or a multi-hit breaks Focus Sash (dossier crack)
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Mega Heracross Pin Missile, 3 hits, KOed a full-HP 129 HP Focus Sash Parasect outright. Skill Link is the clean answer and it works.

strategy_checks.check: Red Card drags the attacker out
strategy_checks.evidence: T3 Incineroar's Knock Off removed the Red Card and the card did not activate - item removal resolved ahead of the card. Worth knowing: Knock Off is a clean answer to this slot, not a trade.

strategy_checks.check: Sap Sipper punishes a Grass move
strategy_checks.evidence: No member of my party carried a Grass move; Kartana's Leaf Blade was deliberately never clicked. The ability changed my play even though it never fired.

protect_note: Sophie's roster has one Protect (Delphox) and one Spiky-Shield-class move (none). Delphox never used Protect in this run - it attacked on both of its turns, which was correct with a 4x Heat Wave target on the field. No empty guarding to report.

ai_defects.board: Sawsbuck (L36, Coba Berry, full HP) beside Forretress at 86/126, against Incineroar (Fire/Dark, 109 HP) and Mega Heracross (Bug/Fighting, 101 HP)
ai_defects.chosen: MOVE_DOUBLE_EDGE into Incineroar - Normal, 1x into Fire/Dark, with recoil
ai_defects.better: MOVE_HIGH_HORSEPOWER into Incineroar - Ground, 2x into Fire/Dark, no recoil, and the exact move the dossier says replaced Helping Hand for 'direct physical coverage'. Roughly double the damage for no self-harm. Horn Leech into Mega Heracross would also have been better than Double-Edge into a resist-neutral target.
ai_defects.note: Suggests the damage scorer may be preferring raw base power (120 vs 95) over the type multiplier for this matchup, or that Double-Edge's recoil is under-penalised. Worth checking against other Double-Edge/High Horsepower holders in the campaign.

level_changes.reason: Brief rule 5 / AGENTS.md review threshold: first optimized attempt won in 3 turns with 1 player faint. Forretress is the lowest member of the team at offset 0 against 1/2/4, and unlike the usual lowest-offset case it is the member that earned a level - it laid Spikes that actually chipped a switch-in and it found the 4x Body Press twice, taking the only Pokemon I lost. Deliberately not applied to Parasect (already +4 and it never got to act, so a fifth level buys nothing) or Sawsbuck (its problem is move selection, not level - see AI defect 1; AGENTS.md says fix the AI defect before compensating with levels).

cooler: The woodland hazard/redirection concept is sound and Parasect genuinely earns its slot on paper - Spore plus Rage Powder plus Wide Guard is three different ways to buy a partner a turn, and almost nothing else in the campaign does that. The problem is structural, not thematic: Parasect is the slowest thing on the team, it is 4x weak to Fire, it holds a Focus Sash that any multi-hit or spread move erases, and it is carrying a +4 offset to compensate. All of that money is spent on a Pokemon that, in this run, entered and died without pressing a button. Concrete suggestion for a later pass: give the redirection job a body that survives its entry turn. Swapping Parasect's Focus Sash for a Sitrus Berry or an Eviolite-class bulk item is outside a levels-only pass, so the cheaper structural fix is ordering - Parasect belongs in the lead pair beside Forretress, where Rage Powder can cover the Spikes turn and Spore can land before the field is on fire, rather than arriving fourth into a board that already beat it. Second idea: Delphox and Parasect both want the same turn. Delphox's Heat Wave is 4x into its own ally Parasect's Bug/Grass in a spread format - the two halves of this team are quietly at war, and that is a more interesting thing to fix than a level.
authored_set_legality: No legality problem found. Sturdy, Dry Skin, Sap Sipper and Blaze were all live with the printed items; Forretress's authored 0 Speed IV for Gyro Ball is intentional and Gyro Ball was never reached.
